rules.title: Review permissions are explicit and read-only
rules.check: Workflow or job permissions are absent, broad, or incompatible with a read-only reviewer.
rules.claimBoundary: Static indicator only; effective repository permissions require platform evidence.
rules.remediation: Declare the narrowest read-only permissions needed by the review job.
rules.verification: Inspect the effective token permissions in a safe test repository.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: An inherited organization policy can be narrower than the file indicates.

rules.title: Untrusted triggers do not combine with privileged execution
rules.check: pull_request_target, untrusted checkout, or secret-bearing steps create a risky combination.
rules.evidence: Parsed events, jobs, and steps only.
rules.claimBoundary: Static indicator only; analyzed text is never executed.
rules.remediation: Separate untrusted PR analysis from privileged contexts and secrets.
rules.verification: Exercise the workflow with an untrusted synthetic pull request.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: A separately enforced runner policy may block the risky path.

rules.title: Third-party actions are immutable
rules.check: Third-party uses entries are not pinned to immutable commit SHAs.
rules.claimBoundary: Pin shape is observable; action trustworthiness is not evaluated.
rules.remediation: Pin third-party actions to reviewed full commit SHAs.
rules.verification: Confirm each external action reference resolves to the reviewed SHA.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: Local actions and immutable first-party references may not need the same treatment.

rules.title: Triggers avoid duplicate review runs
rules.check: Trigger or path filters can create duplicate or unnecessary review runs.
rules.claimBoundary: Savings remain inferred without run telemetry.
rules.remediation: Use mutually exclusive triggers and intentional path filters.
rules.verification: Compare run IDs and trigger reasons in imported telemetry.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: Intentional duplicate runs for different review scopes are valid.

rules.title: Superseded reviews are cancelled
rules.check: Missing or weak concurrency cancellation may waste runs.
rules.claimBoundary: Static indicator only; cancellation effectiveness needs telemetry.
rules.remediation: Add a scoped concurrency group with cancel-in-progress for superseded reviews.
rules.verification: Observe a superseded synthetic run ending as cancelled.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: Serialized queues can be intentional for rate-limited dependencies.

rules.title: Review jobs have bounded timeouts
rules.check: Review jobs or expensive steps lack bounded timeouts.
rules.evidence: Parsed job and step timeout fields.
rules.claimBoundary: Static indicator only; runtime duration needs telemetry.
rules.remediation: Set explicit job and expensive-step timeout limits.
rules.verification: Confirm timeout behavior with a synthetic delayed step outside production.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: A stricter platform-level timeout may exist outside the workflow.

rules.title: Review context is bounded
rules.check: Checkout depth, path filters, or context collection appear broader than required.
rules.claimBoundary: Scope is inferred; no savings claim without run telemetry.
rules.remediation: Declare the smallest context scope that preserves review quality.
rules.verification: Benchmark a paired corpus before changing context scope.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: Cross-file review can legitimately require broader context.

rules.title: Untrusted event fields are not interpolated into execution
rules.check: Untrusted event fields appear in shell or prompt interpolation.
rules.evidence: Parsed expressions and inert shell text.
rules.claimBoundary: Static indicator only; no shell or expression is evaluated.
rules.remediation: Pass untrusted values as inert data through a reviewed boundary.
rules.verification: Test with a synthetic hostile event value in an isolated environment.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: A value can be safely quoted by code not declared as an input.

rules.title: Publishing is bounded and verified
rules.check: Review flow can post unlimited, duplicate, or unverified comments.
rules.evidence: Parsed permissions, steps, and prompt indicators.
rules.claimBoundary: Static indicator only; actual comment behavior needs telemetry.
rules.remediation: Require evidence, deduplicate findings, and enforce a comment budget.
rules.verification: Inspect imported publish telemetry for duplicate and unverified findings.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: A separately enforced publisher can provide limits not visible here.
